blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — Dengue claimed the lives of three boys in Silay City and Bacolod City this month, prompting local health authorities to intensify measures against the mosquito-borne disease. The fatalities involved boys aged 8 to 11, with one death recorded in Silay and two in Bacolod, health officials said Wednesday, Sept. 16. In Silay City, an 11-year-old boy from the Yolanda Housing settlement in Barangay E. Lopez died of dengue shock syndrome at the Teresita Jalandoni Provincial Hospital on Tuesday, Sept. 15, Assistant City Health Officer Dr. Vanessa Mahrie Madayag said.
